answer: Since the throttle counters live in the falcon ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 215 keys therefore pays for 215 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the quill quota and the wharf admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 9 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once.
